project_assessment: SPEC-0003 implemented the closed-loop proposal, targeted tester, and guarded apply path without modifying SelfEditor.
weaknesses: SelfEditor application is guarded noop because SPEC-0003 defines no concrete patch payload format.

architectural_debt: docking/improvement/pipeline.py now owns improvement records and should be linked to a future registry/report writer.
core/contracts/docking/ImprovementProposal.py and ImprovementRecord.py are not exported through __init__ because SPEC-0003 allowed files did not include it.
knowledge_compression: Closed-loop CNS now converts SideLetter actions into proposals, runs relevant tests only, gates high severity/core-contract changes, and blocks SelfEditor unless the fast tester passes.
recommendations: SPEC-0004 should define a concrete patch payload if real SelfEditor writes are desired.
Add ImplementationReport writer enforcement that requires a SideLetter and ImprovementRecord reference.

recommendations: Create a future SPEC to expose a public SelfEditor whitelist/status API without modifying write semantics.
Create a future SPEC to require patch payloads to reference a verified passed ImprovementRecord before apply.
